title: Home Comfort Financing Late Fee Step Schedule by Earlier Late Fees
content:
On Home Comfort Financing accounts the scheduled late fee steps down with the number of late fees posted on the account within the late-fee lookback: when none was posted it is $25.00, when exactly one was posted it is $32.00, and when two or more were posted it is the plan's late fee.

| Late fees already posted on the account within the late-fee lookback | Scheduled late fee |
|---|---|
| none | $25.00 |
| exactly one | $32.00 |
| two or more | the plan's late fee |

The late fees counted are those already on the account when the new fee is worked out; the fee being worked out is not among them. A late fee counts by its posting date.

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- An account with no late fee in the lookback: the scheduled late fee is $25.00.
- An account with one late fee in the lookback and another posted before the lookback begins: only the one inside counts, so the scheduled late fee is $32.00.
- An account with two late fees in the lookback: the scheduled late fee is the plan's late fee.

## Basis Q&A

**Does the fee for the current statement period count toward its own step?** No. Only late fees already posted within the lookback are counted.

**Is the step schedule the same on every plan?** Yes: $25.00 for none, $32.00 for exactly one; for two or more, the plan's late fee of the account's plan.
